title: Shared brand mail layout and template registry
summary: Starts the email templates work with one shared MyAPES Account email design and a list of every email the app sends.
changes: Add a shared MyAPES Account email layout with the logo, footer, and Help link, ready for every email.
Keep one list of every email the app sends, with a name, a description, and whether it is a security, service, or optional email.
Tickets, Cases, and Consultations add their own update emails to that list.
version_rationale: Minor: opens the 0.42 line for email templates and outbound mail. Emails look and send the same as before.
validation: composer pre-merge on the pull request branch.
known_limitations: Ticket, case, consultation, and Staff Login reminder emails keep the plain default design until later 0.42 releases.
rollback: Redeploy the previous release package. No database change is involved.
